unchanged_native_originals: Use exactly MG11 native FIT, native choice and original selected feedback. Only fresh evaluator source seeds change. No manual stage or routing.
new_conventional: Train separate on identical authentic selected 1664 FIT sample stream; independent empirical public exact-state/action transition counts. At a source state, each action score: 5 if known successor public IMAGE differs (not direction alone), +2 if its successor was novel when observed, -3 times current episode action count, -5 for observed public self-loop; bonus +2 if a known successor has a different-image two-step observed action. Untried action = 1. Tie via current public SHA first byte modulo 7. Learn only own actual source selected outcomes. At most 4096 stored transitions. No action oracle, world map or fixed door route.
metrics: authentic original positive goal reward after opening in same episode
original front door opening: selected toggle 5, type4 before/after, state nonzero to zero
original closing: source state zero to nonzero
repeated toggle/reclosure within 8 actual steps after opening
forward action selected within 8 steps of opening
public image changes within 8 steps of opening (direction-only not counted)
actual source held key and front-door
native and conventional source cold checkpoint equality
two independent canonical full source traces
positive_rule: Both unchanged native Go DK12 and Ygg R16 must each earn at least one authentic original goal reward AFTER an actual original source door opening in the SAME episode. Else negative. Even if positive, engineering-only, no independent science.
controls: All seven original MG11 source-only arms plus separately authored stronger two-step conventional, no shared internal answers.
authority: No merges, original accepted native source, G29/Atlas waiver, controller, scientific first use or production changes.
